firstPlayerRule: The player to the dealer’s left goes first, and play continues clockwise. After each round, the player to the dealer’s left deals next.
houseFallback: The rules do not say who deals the first round; use the picker to choose the first dealer.
clarifications: Each round deals one more card, from 3 cards up to 13.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted PDF and extracted its text with pdftotext. "PLAY: 1. The player to the dealer’s left goes first and play continues clockwise." Step 9: "The player to the dealer’s left shuffles all of the cards and deals the next round." Imprint: © 2019 Cannei, LLC.
uncertainty: The rules do not say how the first dealer is chosen.
